words.definition: n. 有轨电车；电车轨道

examples.en: Most commuters in the city travel to work by tram.
examples.zh: 这座城市大多数通勤者乘有轨电车上班。

examples.en: The city expanded its tram network to ease traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 该市扩建了有轨电车网络以缓解交通拥堵。

words.usage: 英式英语指有轨电车，美式多说 streetcar 或 trolley；by tram 乘电车；tram line 电车轨道；交通类阅读常与 commute、congestion 同现。
words.mnemonic: 像 train（火车）的小兄弟，轨道上跑 → 电车

words.definition: n. 一条（面包） vi. 闲逛，游荡

examples.en: She bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery on the corner.
examples.zh: 她在街角的面包店买了一条新鲜面包。

examples.en: He spent the whole afternoon loafing around the house.
examples.zh: 他在房子里闲逛了整整一下午。

words.usage: 名词复数 loaves，f 变 ves，常考不规则变化；a loaf of bread 一条面包；动词 loaf around 闲逛、虚度；派生 loafer 游手好闲者。
collocations: a loaf of bread 一条面包
half a loaf 半条面包
words.mnemonic: 吃饱一条面包就去闲逛 → loaf 名动两义

words.definition: n. 营养，滋养；营养学

examples.en: Good nutrition is essential for children's physical development.
examples.zh: 良好的营养对儿童身体发育至关重要。

examples.en: The course covers food science and human nutrition.
examples.zh: 这门课程涵盖食品科学与人类营养学。

words.usage: 不可数名词，指营养或营养学；同根词群均为考点：nutrient 营养素、nutritious 有营养的、malnutrition 营养不良、nourish 滋养。
words.mnemonic: nutr(营养) 同根 nurture → nutrition 营养

words.definition: n. 保留，保持；记忆力；滞留

examples.en: The company introduced bonuses to improve employee retention.
examples.zh: 公司推出奖金制度以提高员工留任率。

examples.en: Adequate sleep plays a key role in memory retention.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠在记忆保持中起着关键作用。

words.usage: 由 retain 派生的名词；商务语境指员工留任：employee retention；心理学指记忆保持：memory retention；另有水分滞留之义。
words.mnemonic: retain 的名词 → 留在手中不放 → 保留

words.definition: n. 全套服装；全套装备 vt. 配备

examples.en: She wore a brand-new outfit to the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 她穿着一身崭新的套装参加毕业典礼。

examples.en: The expedition was outfitted with the latest climbing gear.
examples.zh: 探险队配备了最新型登山装备。

words.usage: 可数名词，指一套服装或全套装备；动词 outfit sb with sth 为其配备，过去式双写 t 加 ed；美式口语还可指公司、团队。
collocations: a full outfit 全套装备
words.mnemonic: out+fit(合身) → 里外合身的一套 → 装束

words.definition: n. 惊愕，沮丧 vt. 使惊愕；使失望

examples.en: To the dismay of environmentalists, the dam project was approved.
examples.zh: 令环保人士失望的是，大坝项目获得了批准。

examples.en: The sudden resignation of the minister dismayed the whole cabinet.
examples.zh: 部长的突然辞职令整个内阁惊愕。

words.usage: 动词多用于被动：be dismayed at/by 对…感到惊愕；名词常用于 to one's dismay 令某人沮丧的是，完形高频；in dismay 惊愕地。
collocations: to one's dismay 令某人沮丧的是
be dismayed at 对…感到惊愕
fill sb with dismay 使充满沮丧
words.mnemonic: dis(不)+may(能) → 事与愿违 → 沮丧惊愕

words.definition: v./n. 反叛，起义；反抗 vt. 使厌恶

examples.en: The peasants revolted against heavy taxation.
examples.zh: 农民们反抗沉重的赋税。

examples.en: The harsh conditions sparked a revolt among the prisoners.
examples.zh: 恶劣的条件在囚犯中引发了暴动。

words.usage: 不及物动词 revolt against sb/sth 反抗；名词 rise in revolt 揭竿而起；另有使厌恶义；派生 revolting 令人作呕的。
collocations: rise in revolt 揭竿而起
a peasant revolt 农民起义
words.mnemonic: re(回)+volt(转) → 把权柄翻转回来 → 反叛

words.definition: n. 大堂，门厅；利益集团 v. 游说

examples.en: Delegates gathered in the hotel lobby before the opening session.
examples.zh: 开幕式前代表们聚集在酒店大堂。

examples.en: Environmental groups lobbied the government for stricter laws.
examples.zh: 环保团体游说政府制定更严格的法律。

words.usage: 名词指大堂或利益集团；动词 lobby sb for sth 游说争取、lobby to do 为做某事而游说；派生 lobbyist 说客，美国政治阅读高频。
collocations: a powerful lobby 强大的利益集团
words.mnemonic: 在大厅里「唠嗑」议员 → lobby 游说

words.definition: vi. 撤退，退却；退缩 n. 撤退；静修处

examples.en: The army retreated to safer positions under heavy fire.
examples.zh: 在猛烈炮火下，部队撤退到更安全的阵地。

examples.en: Faced with criticism, he retreated from his earlier position.
examples.zh: 面对批评，他放弃了先前的立场。

words.usage: 不及物动词，retreat from 撤离、retreat to 退往；名词引申静修处 a mountain retreat；beat a retreat 匆匆撤走；反义 advance。
collocations: beat a retreat 匆匆撤退
a mountain retreat 山间静居
words.mnemonic: re(回)+treat(拉) → 往回拉队伍 → 撤退

words.definition: n. 托儿所；苗圃；婴儿房

examples.en: Her daughter attends a nursery near their apartment.
examples.zh: 她女儿上他们公寓附近的一家托儿所。

examples.en: He bought several fruit trees from a local nursery.
examples.zh: 他从当地苗圃买了几棵果树。

words.usage: 名词多义：托儿所、苗圃、婴儿房；nursery school 幼儿园、nursery rhymes 童谣；与 nurse、nursing、nurture 同族辨形。
collocations: a day nursery 日间托儿所
words.mnemonic: nurse(护理)+ry(场所) → 护理幼儿苗苗之地

words.definition: adj. 高耸的；崇高的；高傲的

examples.en: The village lies at the foot of a lofty mountain.
examples.zh: 村庄坐落在一座高山脚下。

examples.en: She has lofty ambitions of becoming a research scientist.
examples.zh: 她怀有成为科研人员的远大抱负。

words.usage: 本义高耸的：a lofty tower；引申崇高的 lofty ideals 与高傲的 a lofty manner；名词 loft 阁楼；副词 loftily。

confusables.note: n.阁楼，去 y 即名词根

collocations: a lofty goal 宏伟目标
words.mnemonic: loft(阁楼)+y → 高及阁楼 → 高耸的

words.definition: vt. 保留，保持；留住；记住

examples.en: The town has retained much of its traditional character.
examples.zh: 这座小镇保留了许多传统风貌。

examples.en: Older adults may take longer to retain new information.
examples.zh: 年长者记住新信息可能需要更长时间。

words.usage: 及物动词，正式用语：retain control 保持控制、retain information 记住信息；名词 retention；口语近义 keep；反义 abandon。
words.mnemonic: re(回)+tain(持) → 持回不放手 → 保留

words.definition: adj. 数字的，数值的；用数字表示的

examples.en: Arrange the files in numerical order before submission.
examples.zh: 提交前请把文件按数字顺序排列。

examples.en: The entrance test measures both verbal and numerical reasoning.
examples.zh: 入学测试同时考查语言推理与数字推理。

words.usage: 常搭 numerical order 数字顺序、numerical data 数值数据；同根 numerous 众多的、enumerate 列举、innumerable 无数的，注意辨析。
collocations: numerical skills 数字运算能力
words.mnemonic: numer(数)+ical → 用数字表示的

words.definition: n. 短途出游，远足；公开露面

examples.en: The club organized an outing to the national park.
examples.zh: 俱乐部组织了一次去国家公园的远足。

examples.en: The children enjoyed their first outing of the term.
examples.zh: 孩子们尽情享受本学期的第一次出游。

words.usage: 可数名词，多指集体短途出游：a family outing；go for an outing 去郊游；由 go out 派生；与形容词 outdoor 区分词性。
collocations: a family outing 家庭出游
go for an outing 去郊游
a school outing 学校郊游
words.mnemonic: go out(外出)+ing → 集体外出的活动

words.definition: n. 茎，柄，梗 vt. 悄悄跟踪；昂首踱步

examples.en: The corn stalks swayed gently in the summer breeze.
examples.zh: 玉米秆在夏日微风中轻轻摇曳。

examples.en: Police confirmed that the actress had been stalked by a stranger.
examples.zh: 警方证实那位女演员曾被一名陌生人跟踪骚扰。

words.usage: 名词茎、柄、梗；动词指跟踪骚扰或昂首踱步：stalk out of 愤然离开；派生 stalker 跟踪骚扰者；植物义近 stem。
collocations: stalk a celebrity 跟踪名人
stalk out of 愤然离开
words.mnemonic: 躲进麦秆（stalk）后偷偷跟踪 → 茎；跟踪

words.definition: adj. 分离的，不连续的；离散的

examples.en: The course breaks the task into several discrete steps.
examples.zh: 课程把任务分解为几个独立的步骤。

examples.en: The device records data in discrete units of one second.
examples.zh: 该设备以一秒为离散单位记录数据。

words.usage: 学术形容词：discrete variables 离散变量、discrete units 独立单元；与同音词 discreet 谨慎的仅差 e 的位置，考研经典拼写辨析。
words.mnemonic: discreet 眯双眼(ee)谨慎；discrete 分离

words.definition: adj. 视条件而定的 n. 分遣队；代表团

examples.en: The subsidy is contingent upon meeting safety standards.
examples.zh: 补贴以符合安全标准为前提。

examples.en: A large contingent of fans traveled to the final.
examples.zh: 一大批球迷前往决赛现场。

words.usage: 形容词短语 be contingent on/upon 取决于；名词指分遣队、代表团；派生 contingency 意外事故，contingency plan 应急预案高频。
collocations: a contingency plan 应急预案
a contingent of troops 一支特遣部队
words.mnemonic: be contingent on 拉帐篷(tent)定条件 → 视…而定

words.definition: n. 肝，肝脏；过某种生活的人

examples.en: The doctor advised him to drink less to protect his liver.
examples.zh: 医生建议他少喝酒以保护肝脏。

examples.en: Long-term alcohol abuse can cause severe liver damage.
examples.zh: 长期酗酒会造成严重的肝损伤。

words.usage: 器官名词，与 lung 肺、kidney 肾同属健康话题词群；liver damage 肝损伤、fatty liver 脂肪肝；勿与形容词 lively 混淆。
words.mnemonic: live(活)+r → 人活着全靠肝 → 肝脏

words.definition: n./adj. 零售（的） v. 零售

examples.en: Online retail has expanded rapidly over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年间在线零售迅速扩张。

examples.en: The company sells its products retail rather than wholesale.
examples.zh: 该公司以零售而非批发方式销售产品。

words.usage: 名词、形容词均常用，与 wholesale 批发相对；sell retail 以零售方式出售；派生 retailer 零售商；retail price 零售价。
collocations: sell retail 以零售方式销售
words.mnemonic: re(再)+tail(切) → 一再切小零售 → 零售

words.definition: n. 讨厌的人（或事）；麻烦事；公害

examples.en: The constant noise from the construction site is a real nuisance.
examples.zh: 工地持续不断的噪音实在令人厌烦。

examples.en: He was fined for causing a public nuisance in the park.
examples.zh: 他因在公园扰乱公共秩序而被罚款。

words.usage: 可数名词，指讨厌的人或事；make a nuisance of oneself 惹人嫌；public nuisance 法律义公害；句型 It is a nuisance that。
collocations: make a nuisance of oneself 惹人讨厌
a nuisance to sb 对…是个麻烦
words.mnemonic: nuis(近 annoy 惹恼)+ance → 惹人厌之物
